evals.prompt: Orchestra, receive this ticket: the request is to add a shared skill for validating plugin manifests. Check it and prepare it for my review; don't start the work.
evals.expected_output: Assess the selected ticket, classify tools/skills work as Admin, request scoped context when available, update the ticket with an attributed intake packet, set Human review, and stop for a human decision.
expectations: Does not start implementation or claim a downstream route.
Reports source lookup as pending unless Wiki Companion actually ran.
Does not invent plan content or approval.

evals.prompt: This ticket continues the existing research milestone discussion. Receive the same ticket and summarize what is still open; don't make a duplicate.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the identified ticket, preserve its category and history, update the intake packet, and prepare it for human review with remaining open questions.
expectations: Checks identity before assuming the ticket is the same.
Preserves existing intent and does not create another ticket.
Does not silently change category or imply route approval.

evals.prompt: The Wiki Companion capability is unavailable. Receive this ticket, record that gap, and prepare it for my review.
evals.expected_output: Record the unavailable context check as a limitation, set Human review when supported, and present the packet without claiming context completeness.
